# Nowazone

> Nowazone is a vendor-neutral FinOps as a Service and multi-cloud cost optimization partner. We help enterprise and mid-market organizations maximize technology value, reduce avoidable cloud spend, and establish continuous financial engineering practices across AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), Databricks, and AI/GPU workloads.

## Core Capabilities
- **FinOps as a Service (FaaS)**: Dedicated FinOps pods delivering continuous Inform, Optimize, and Operate lifecycle governance.
- **Multi-Cloud Cost Management**: Normalized cross-cloud cost visibility aligned with the FinOps Open Cost & Usage Specification (FOCUS 1.4).
- **AI & GPU Tokenomics**: Token-level cost allocation, model rightsizing, inference cost benchmarking, and GPU cluster utilization audits.
- **Licensing & Partner Procurement**: Official Microsoft CSP and Google Cloud licensing reseller optimization.
- **Cloud Architecture & Migration**: FinOps-planned landing zones, cutover waves, and workload modernization.

## Engagement & Pricing Model
- **Free Cost X-Ray Assessment**: 24-hour diagnostic review under NDA with read-only access.
- **Fixed Diagnostic / Retainers**: Transparent flat-fee pricing starting from $750 diagnostic or $1,500/mo retainer.
- **Zero Percentage Cut**: We never take a percentage of client savings; pricing is fixed and predictable.
